```{r}
#| label: cgi-ancova-interaction-unadjusted
#| include: false

# Prepare CGI data for ANCOVA
# CGI is different from other outcomes:
# - cgis_soi (baseline) is the severity at Visit 1
# - cgi_i (Week 16) is the improvement at Visit 3
# We rename cgis to cgi at Visit 1 so fit_cgi_ancova_interaction treats it as baseline
data_cgi <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cgis = cgis_soi |> as.numeric(),
    cgi = cgi_i |> as.numeric()
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # At baseline (Visit 1), replace cgi with cgis
    cgi = dplyr::if_else(
      redcap_event_name == "Baseline Visit (Visit 1)",
      cgis,
      cgi
    )
  )

cgi_var <- c("cgi")
cgi_label <- c("CGI-Improvement")

names(cgi_label) = cgi_var

# fit ANCOVA models with Treatment*Age Group interaction (unadjusted) using CGI-specific function
cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj <- lapply(
  cgi_var,
  function(x) fit_cgi_ancova_interaction(
    dataset = data_cgi,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = cgi_label[x],
    demo_vars = NULL,
    strata_var = strata_var,
    strata_label = strata_label
  )
)
names(cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj) <- cgi_label

# extract tables from fit_cgi_ancova_interaction output
cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj),
    function(x) {
      cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cgi-ancova-interaction-unadjusted
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "CGI - Unadjusted ANCOVA results with Treatment*Age Group interaction showing LS means (95% CI)
#|    for baseline CGI-SOI (Severity of Illness) and full ANCOVA model CGI-I (Improvement), with between-group
#|    differences stratified by age group. {data_caption}")

cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft <- cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary |>
  dplyr::select(-interaction_p) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    Age_Group = "Age Group",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    full_p = "Full Model",
    full_p_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    full_m = "Full Model",
    full_m_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    full_contrast_mean = "Full Model Diff",
    full_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    interaction_est = "Interaction Estimate",
    interaction_ci = "95% CI"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences", ""),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 5, 5, 4, 2)
  ) |>
  flextable::merge_v(j = c("Outcome", "interaction_est", "interaction_ci")) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1:2, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::align(j = c(17, 18), align = "center", part = "body") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(2, 7, 12), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-cgi-ancova-interaction-unadjusted-forest
#| fig-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "CGI - Forest plot showing Treatment*Age Group interaction term (unadjusted). {data_caption}")

plot_ancova_interaction_forest(
  obj = cgi_ancova_intrxn_unadj,
  labels = cgi_label,
  min_mult = 1.1,
  max_mult = 1.1,
  arrow_labs = strata_levels
)
```
